status.en: 7 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 22% fewer than the week before, most of them in Dioura, Siguiri and Mopti.
status.nb: 7 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 22 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Dioura, Siguiri og Mopti.

summary.en: Jihadist militants have intensified attacks in Niger state, killing dozens of civilians, 11 soldiers in the southeast, at least 16 soldiers near the Malian border, and 25 soldiers in another strike, while Fulani communities suffered mass killings of at least 64 people. In Mali, Russian forces have suffered heavy losses, with reports of more than 300 Russian soldiers dead as Moscow supports the military junta. A Russian envoy claims Ukrainian officers are training Sahel armed groups on drones, linking external actors to the insurgency. The Sahel jihadist insurgency caused 4,159 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Jihadistmilitante har økt angrepene i Niger-staten, og har drept dusinvis av sivile, 11 soldater i sørøst, minst 16 soldater nær den maliske grensen, og 25 soldater i et annet angrep, mens Fulani-samfunn opplevde massedrap på minst 64 personer. I Mali har russiske styrker lidd store tap, med rapporter om mer enn 300 russiske soldater drept mens Moskva støtter den militære junten. En russisk sendebud hevder at ukrainske offiserer trener Sahel-bevæpnede grupper i droner, og knytter eksterne aktører til opprøret. Ifølge UCDP forårsaket den saheliske jihadistopprøret 4 159 dødsfall i kamper i 2024.

background.title: War in the Sahel
background.extract: The War in the Sahel, also known as the Sahel War, is a multi-sided armed conflict that has been ongoing since 2012. The conflict mainly takes place in the countries of Mali, Niger and Burkina Faso.
